task.title: Port three-team deals
task.description:
## Why
When a buyer cannot pay in what the seller wants, the report routes the deal through a third team.

## Steps
1. Port `three_team_deals`, `bridge_fits` and `_bridge_items` from `rebuild/trades.py`.
2. Translate the `BridgeFitsTest` cases in `tests/test_board.py` into Vitest.
3. Keep the rule that a failure in this section does not fail the report.

## Done when
- The three-team parity test passes for every fixture.
- The translated bridge tests pass.
